# PROCESS — cand_0003 (parent = cand_0001 champion, val 0.450)

Strategy: cand_0002 (an ADDITIVE `change_cabin` composite, primitives kept) was
REJECTED at val 0.417 with `broke={}` — no passing task regressed, the DB-verified
tool did no damage, the move simply did not clear the noise bar. The framework's own
note: *"the lever is POWER or SIZE, not a redesign — make the effect bigger."* So
this iteration keeps every accepted cand_0001 guard untouched and makes the modify
lever UNAVOIDABLE instead of optional: I REMOVE the three raw update primitives from
the exposed toolset and replace them with ONE composite write tool
(`modify_reservation`) plus a read-only pricing tool (`quote_change`). The agent can
no longer corrupt a cabin-only change (dropped/duplicated/invented segments) or bail
because it cannot pre-compute an amount — the only modify path now rebuilds segments
verbatim and computes the amount in code.

## Ranked issue list (carried from cand_0001/0002 trajectories + LEDGER)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Cabin/flight change corrupted or refused | 11, 37, 17, 22 | agent mangles the `flights` arg on a cabin-only change, or refuses because it can't compute the fare diff | BEHAVIORAL | REMOVE primitives; force `modify_reservation` (segments rebuilt verbatim) + `quote_change` (exact amount) |
| 2 | Multi-change requests done partially / wrong order | 17, 22 | cabin + passengers + baggage needed together; agent does one, stalls, or mis-sequences payment_history | BEHAVIORAL | `modify_reservation` applies all in gold order (flights→passengers→baggages) in one call |
| 3 | Exact-total not communicated | 11, 23 | agent speaks per-passenger figure, not ×npax total | KNOWLEDGE | `quote_change.quote` + `modify_reservation.payment_summary` hand the exact total; policy rule kept |
| 4 | Duplicate passenger padding | 17 | agent repeats a passenger, count check rejects | BEHAVIORAL | dedup of identical (name+dob) entries inside `update_reservation_passengers` + enriched error |
| 5 | Wrong reservation targeted (city vs airport) | 17 | agent defaults to first id / can't map city→airport | KNOWLEDGE | policy "Match by CITY" metro map (NY/Chicago/…) + unique-match rule |
| — | STALL / multi-cert identity / wrong payment choice | 40, 12, 23, 22 | no safe general code lever | BEHAVIORAL (hard) | prose only (unchanged) |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1/2 | tools (remove) | tools.py `REMOVE_TOOLS` | drop `update_reservation_flights/passengers/baggages` from the exposed set (still callable on the class for delegation) → forces the safe composite path | yes — the only modify tool now yields identical DB state to the gold primitive calls |
| 1/2 | tools (composite WRITE) | tools.py `modify_reservation` | one call: cabin/flights/passengers/baggages; cabin-only reuses current segments verbatim; delegates to the accepted primitive bodies in gold order; returns consolidated `payment_summary` | yes — reproduces gold DB hash (verified 11/12/17/22/37), safe no-op with no args |
| 1/3 | tools (read) | tools.py `quote_change` | read-only exact charge/refund preview; no mutation | yes — DB-hash unchanged (verified), returns −5244 for task 11 |
| 4 | tools (in-body) | tools.py `update_reservation_passengers` | dedup identical passengers before the count check + actionable error naming current count/names | yes — no-op on already-distinct lists |
| 1/2/3 | prompt | policy.md | "all modifications go through `modify_reservation`"; cabin-only omits `flights`; multi-change in one call; `quote_change` for amounts; "never refuse/transfer because you can't compute the amount"; worked examples | yes |
| 5 | prompt | policy.md | "Match by CITY" metro map + unique city-level match beats first-listed / transfer | yes |
| — | prompt | policy.md | removed all references to the 3 deleted primitives; kept exact-total rule, do-not-stall, softness clause | yes |

## Verify-the-fix (live DB + real adapter, `/home/skillberry/.cache/capevolve-ci/venv/bin/python`)
- Registration through the ACTUAL adapter (`_build_candidate_tools`): exposed toolset =
  13 tools — `modify_reservation` + `quote_change` present, all three primitives absent;
  JSON schema builds for both new tools.
- `modify_reservation` reproduces the GOLD db hash: task 11 (GV1N64 → basic_economy),
  task 12 (YAX4DR bags=2), task 37 (M20IZO → business), task 17/22 combined (FQ8APE
  economy + Omar Rossi + 3 bags, applied in one call) — all `True`.
- Cabin-only (`flights` omitted) == explicit-current-segments: `True` (segment reuse is exact).
- `quote_change` for task 11 returns `amount=-5244`, DB hash unchanged: `True`.
- No-arg `modify_reservation` is a safe no-op (DB unchanged, returns a "no changes" summary).
- Delegation still works through the adapter-filtered instance (hidden primitive called internally): `True`.

## Process & features used
- Serial single session, grounded on the live tau2 DB and the real airline adapter before
  keeping anything. Every DB claim above is a hash-equality check against the gold primitive
  calls, not an inference.
- Prior iterations read: cand_0001 (ACCEPT 0.450) and cand_0002 (reject 0.417) PROCESS/diff/
  JOURNAL. I kept all cand_0001 guards verbatim (they are no-op on correct input, never in
  `broke`), and I did NOT re-ship cand_0002's additive-only `change_cabin` — the RESULT proved
  "additive + primitives kept" is too weak; this iteration makes the same tool mandatory and
  broadens it to all four modify dimensions.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- All cand_0001 in-body guards (payment normalize/auto-correct, baggage recompute, cancel-flown)
  — verified no-op on correct input, never regressed.
- Narrow return enrichment only (single `payment_summary`/`quote` key) — the wide
  `communicate_to_user` dump was refuted in a prior run; do not re-add it.
- The REMOVE+composite shape: if this clears the gate, it is the general modify surface — do not
  re-expose the raw primitives (they are what the agent corrupts).

## Deliberately skipped
- Task 23 multi-certificate identity (which cert absorbs which booking): no safe general rule.
- Wrong-payment-method trials (22): the user names the method; not guardable.
- Pure STALL/###STOP### (40 t1, 12 t0): infra/user-sim noise, no safe code lever — prose only.
